limits: One recorded cell, one date group, one experimental dataset; five related endpoints are not five independent experiments.
Acquisition RF center and axis were experimentally selected; no independently measured BANC correspondence.
Right hemisphere mirrors the left-eye recording; original wiring is retained for every arm.

Recorded traces retain legacy acquisition-origin resample_poly plus onset-grid interpolation. Predictions use a centered FIR on physical output times; unavailable acquisition phase makes these approximate, not identical observation operators.
The three-sigma circular RF cutoff is an additional frozen implementation assumption beyond the donor finite-arena blur; both providers and numerical refinements use identical support.
The fixed boundary is not an optimized strong BANC baseline. Gain uncertainty is not exhausted.
Biological superiority is unestablished; any win is conditional on this retrospective boundary and cell assignment.
Single selected recording trial per condition; no repeat averaging, SEM, confidence interval or replication claim.
Only the assumed T4c assignment is executed. T4d and sensory gain sensitivity remain unexecuted.

Every request undergoes actual complete-state disk checkpoint restore and exact replay. Campaign checkpoint files are temporary and removed after checking; retained digests and selected-root traces do not permit offline full-state replay.
contract.metric_window: Post-onset 0 through nominal stimulus duration +200ms, inclusive. Peak is maximum signed voltage on this window. Waveform RMSE is per-condition then equal-condition mean. Direction contrast=positive-source-axis peak minus negative; speed contrast=20ms-dwell peak minus80ms-dwell peak.

resource_amendment.basis: Measured native runtime and evidence storage only; no experimental response values read for this amendment.

scoring_observation.operation: Use the already filtered and baseline-subtracted recorded voltage of exactly the selected trial; no repeat averaging and no second filter.

contract.selection: Lexically first eligible recorded cell; flashes at positions -1,0,+1 for 80ms plus center20/160ms; both acquisition-axis motion signs at dwell20/80ms; all eligible repeats. Resource amendment: choose the minimum eligible trial index per condition and primary T4c only, before any renewed observation access.

sources.use: Toy first-order timing values, not measurements.
5.7degree FWHM donor circuit-model blur, transferred to isotropic2D.
First-order 40/100 ms toy-model timescales; not measured BANC kernels.
Acquisition luminance, visual geometry and recorded T4 stimuli.

sensory_boundary.uncertainty: Fixed shared boundary; no fit. Gain scale, first-order kernels, holding and RF shape are assumptions. Native relay-specific gains are unavailable.

contract.win_rule: Descriptive signed difference; no inferential significance with one recorded cell. Endpoint-specific conservative numerical separation thresholds are not biological improvement margins.

outcome_access: Forbidden in freeze, pilot, execute and verify; permitted only after prediction seal in separate scorer.
prediction_policy: Reuse actual full-case qualification trajectories only after every required check passes.
